free_tier.stated: No free tier; a prepaid balance with a USD 10 minimum top-up. First SSH creates the account from the key fingerprint.

retention.stated: Stopped boxes keep their disk and a memory snapshot at USD 0.50/month per x1 slot. No backups are performed, and deleted boxes are permanently removed within 24 hours. Boxes stop when the balance falls below USD 5 and are deleted at USD 0; unused funds are refundable within 3 months.

egress.terms: No transfer allowance or per-GB price is stated. Every box gets direct public IPv6 for raw TCP and UDP, a managed HTTPS endpoint and an email endpoint; bandwidth is shared and may be throttled.

interface_detail: SSH to shellbox.dev for control commands (create, list, duplicate, keepalive, cron, funds) and SSH to a box; scp, sftp and mosh work
tooling: an SSH client: control commands run over ssh shellbox.dev and box access uses ssh, scp and sftp; no REST API or SDK

limits.value: prepaid balance only; boxes auto-stop below USD 5 and are deleted at USD 0
per-IP SSH connection rate limit 200 per minute; shared network bandwidth may be throttled

limits_note: No wall-clock session cap is published; in the default mode a box pauses 120 seconds after the last SSH session disconnects. Network bandwidth is shared and may be throttled.

identity_cost.detail: No card, no email, no signup form: 'your SSH key fingerprint is your account'. Payment is a prepaid Paddle balance with a USD 10 minimum top-up, refundable within 3 months; no card is stored by Shellbox. No hold.

reliability_note: Stopped boxes resume from a memory snapshot in about 3 seconds; auto-stop and deletion are triggered by the prepaid balance, not by time. Network bandwidth is shared and boxes may be throttled.
confidence_note: Price, slot shape, parked rate, keepalive mode, the IPv6/UDP statement and the key-fingerprint signup are all quoted from the single product page read. The per-slot price table rendered without its rows, so only the x1 price (USD 0.02/hour) is known; the x2-x8 prices are unverified.

notes: Arithmetic at 24/7: USD 0.02/hour x 730 = USD 14.60 for 2 vCPU, 4 GB and 50 GB SSD. 10 h/day at 22 days = 220 h = USD 4.40, which is inside the budget only if the box is allowed to sleep. The default mode pauses 120 seconds after the last SSH session disconnects, so a 24/7 workload must be put in keepalive mode explicitly. Runs on bare metal in Hetzner Finland, one region.
